scope: One stronger-compression diagnostic tier for the Llama-3-8B final FDP-EB ablation line; not a redesign of FDP and not a change to existing tiers.

method.profile_line: final FDP-EB Llama-3 ablation; existing frozen component definitions and TRUE_TWO_PASS_FDP_EB mapping
method.normalization: existing mean normalization followed by frozen canonical layer-0 rule
method.only_arm_difference: whether d2 is included in the component sum

resource_target.search_objective: resource-only nearest legal rank schedule to the frozen target
resource_target.if_no_schedule_within_tolerance: select the closest legal schedule and report exact gap; never move target after quality

same_epsilon_native_diagnostic.definition: Apply frozen U-FULL epsilon_base to U-NO-S without retuning; report B_live and per-layer QK/V rank deltas.
same_epsilon_native_diagnostic.quality_evaluation: not run unless schedule exactly equals a resource-controlled primary arm

paired_bootstrap.unit: paired evaluation window/chunk within each dataset
paired_bootstrap.joint_J: independent resampling across Wiki/C4, preserving within-dataset paired indices

audit_note.preselection_read_deviation: A broad read-only inventory initially displayed a pre-existing result summary containing quality fields before Ultra schedule selection. Those values are excluded from candidate generation and selection; selection uses only frozen profile components, rank traces, target, and deterministic resource-gap tie-breaks.
